Contract Generator.contract:
Contract AirportSystem::createStaff(id: Integer,name: String,pswd: String,phone: String,role: Integer,bossid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		boss: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(s|s.Id = bossid),
		staff: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(s|s.Id = id)
	precondition:
		boss.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		if staff.oclIsUndefined() 
		then let newStaff: Staff in
		newStaff.oclIsNew() and
		Staff.allInstance()->includes(newStaff) and
		newStaff.Id = id and
		newStaff.Name = name and
		newStaff.Password = pswd and
		newStaff.Phone = phone and
		newStaff.Role = role and
		newStaff.Boss = boss and
		result = true 
		else staff.Name = name and
		staff.Password = pswd and
		staff.Phone = phone and
		staff.Role = role and
		staff.Boss = boss and
		result = true 
		endif 
}
